title: Marston's Rope Ladders
description: Craftable rope ladders that extend downward for easy vertical traversal.
body:
# Marston's Rope Ladders

A Minecraft mod that adds craftable rope ladders that extend downward for easy vertical traversal.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_08e6f1a0-c3d3-4c1b-8f1e-256f4b6337d3.png)

## Features

*   **Chain Extension**: Click on an existing rope ladder to automatically extend the chain to the first available space below
*   **Cascade Breaking**: Break any rope in a chain and watch them fall one by one
*   **Climbable**: Works just like vanilla ladders
*   **Flammable**: Burns realistically, one block at a time
*   **Water Sensitive**: Rope pops off when touched by water

## Crafting

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_d43f54f8-0fc2-4d7e-93bc-204fe819b4b0.png)

A string above and below a ladder makes 1 Rope Ladder.

## Mechanics

### Placement

*   Click a solid block to place a rope ladder below it
*   Click an existing rope ladder to extend the chain downward
*   Cannot place through water, lava, or other non-air blocks

### Breaking

*   Instant break (no tool required)
*   Breaking any rope triggers a cascade break of all ropes below

## Requirements

*   Minecraft 1.21.11
*   NeoForge 21.11.25-beta or higher

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_36dab781-8b86-40ea-846a-3393b0ce60d9.png)
